verses.text: [A Psalm] of David. To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul.
verses.textZh: （大衛的詩。）耶和華啊，我的心仰望你。

verses.text: O my God, in You I trust, Do not let me be ashamed; Do not let my enemies exult over me.
verses.textZh: 我的神啊，我素來倚靠你；求你不要叫我羞愧，不要叫我的仇敵向我誇勝。

verses.text: Indeed, none of those who wait for You will be ashamed; Those who deal treacherously without cause will be ashamed.
verses.textZh: 凡等候你的必不羞愧；惟有那無故行奸詐的必要羞愧。

verses.text: Make me know Your ways, O LORD; Teach me Your paths.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，求你將你的道指示我，將你的路教訓我！

verses.text: Lead me in Your truth and teach me, For You are the God of my salvation; For You I wait all the day.
verses.textZh: 求你以你的真理引導我，教訓我，因為你是救我的神。我終日等候你。

verses.text: Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and Your lovingkindnesses, For they have been from of old.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，求你記念你的憐憫和慈愛，因為這是亙古以來所常有的。

verses.text: Do not remember the sins of my youth or my transgressions; According to Your lovingkindness remember me, For Your goodness' sake, O LORD.
verses.textZh: 求你不要記念我幼年的罪愆和我的過犯；耶和華啊，求你因你的恩惠，按你的慈愛記念我。

verses.text: Good and upright is the LORD; Therefore He instructs sinners in the way.
verses.textZh: 耶和華是良善正直的，所以他必指示罪人走正路。

verses.text: He leads the humble in justice, And He teaches the humble His way.
verses.textZh: 他必按公平引領謙卑人，將他的道教訓他們。

verses.text: All the paths of the LORD are lovingkindness and truth To those who keep His covenant and His testimonies.
verses.textZh: 凡遵守他的約和他法度的人，耶和華都以慈愛誠實待他。

verses.text: For Your name's sake, O LORD, Pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，求你因你的名赦免我的罪，因為我的罪重大。

verses.text: Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the way he should choose.
verses.textZh: 誰敬畏耶和華，耶和華必指示他當選擇的道路。

verses.text: His soul will abide in prosperity, And his descendants will inherit the land.
verses.textZh: 他必安然居住；他的後裔必承受地土。

verses.text: The secret of the LORD is for those who fear Him, And He will make them know His covenant.
verses.textZh: 耶和華與敬畏他的人親密；他必將自己的約指示他們。

verses.text: My eyes are continually toward the LORD, For He will pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.textZh: 我的眼目時常仰望耶和華，因為他必將我的腳從網裡拉出來。

verses.text: Turn to me and be gracious to me, For I am lonely and afflicted.
verses.textZh: 求你轉向我，憐恤我，因為我是孤獨困苦。

verses.text: The troubles of my heart are enlarged; Bring me out of my distresses.
verses.textZh: 我心裡的愁苦甚多，求你救我脫離我的禍患。

verses.text: Look upon my affliction and my trouble, And forgive all my sins.
verses.textZh: 求你看顧我的困苦，我的艱難，赦免我一切的罪。

verses.text: Look upon my enemies, for they are many, And they hate me with violent hatred.
verses.textZh: 求你察看我的仇敵，因為他們人多，並且痛痛地恨我。

verses.text: Guard my soul and deliver me; Do not let me be ashamed, for I take refuge in You.
verses.textZh: 求你保護我的性命，搭救我，使我不致羞愧，因為我投靠你。

verses.text: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, For I wait for You.
verses.textZh: 願純全、正直保守我，因為我等候你。

verses.text: Redeem Israel, O God, Out of all his troubles.
verses.textZh: 神啊，求你救贖以色列脫離他一切的愁苦。
